description: This file defines the KeyboardService class responsible for handling keyboard events, managing keyboard shortcuts, modifiers, and command execution within a UI application.

classes.name: KeyboardService
classes.description: A class that manages keyboard event handling, shortcut registration, and command execution based on keyboard input.

methods.name: deinit
methods.description: Removes event listeners and clears command handlers, effectively deinitializing the service.

methods.name: addActiveModifier
methods.description: Adds a keyboard modifier to the active set based on platform-specific rules.

methods.name: removeActiveModifier
methods.description: Removes a keyboard modifier from the active set.

methods.name: handleComponentKeyDown
methods.description: Handles key down event for component, adding the modifier.

methods.name: handleComponentKeyUp
methods.description: Handles key up event for component, removing the modifier.

methods.name: handleKeyDown
methods.description: Handles the global key down event, updating modifiers and processing shortcuts.

methods.name: handleKeyUp
methods.description: Handles the global key up event, updating modifiers.

methods.name: updateAllModifiersFromEvent
methods.description: Updates active modifiers based on the keyboard event's modifier state.

methods.name: handleWindowBlur
methods.description: Clears active modifiers when window loses focus.

methods.name: handleKeyboardEvent
methods.description: Processes keyboard events to trigger commands if shortcuts match.

methods.name: handleCommand
methods.description: Executes command callbacks if event matches command shortcut and element conditions.

methods.name: registerShortcut
methods.description: Registers a keyboard shortcut with the service.

methods.name: addCommandHandler
methods.description: Adds a command handler observer and returns a disposer function.

methods.name: addCommandHandlers
methods.description: Adds multiple command handlers and returns a disposer function.

methods.name: keyboardShortcutForCommand
methods.description: Retrieves the platform-specific keyboard shortcut for a command.
